messages:
Mason: Quick heads-up — hotfix for 1.11.x. We need a minimal patch bump (1.11.3 -> 1.11.4) to fix the streaming handler regression that surfaced in prod. Aiming for an expedited cutoff today. Please ack if you can help with cherry-picks, changelog, and a smoke run.

Mason: Patch plan (very small):
```
# checkout release branch
git fetch origin && git checkout -b hotfix/1.11.4 origin/release/1.11
# cherry-pick fix commit
git cherry-pick -x abcdef12  # fixes streaming kv cache overflow
# bump package version
jq '.version="1.11.4"' package.json > package.json.tmp && mv package.json.tmp package.json
git commit -am "bump: 1.11.4 (hotfix)"
```

Tessa: @Mason I can own the changelog stanza and the release notes bullet. Will draft short impact + mitigation. ETA 20m.

Jay: I can take the cherry-pick and run the smoke tests. FYI CI has been flaky on e2e/streaming lately — see CI job 4321 that times out sometimes. Recommend we set cutoff in ~30m to avoid long-running reruns.

Jay: If you hit a conflict during cherry-pick, try this pattern:
```
# resolve produced conflicts from kv_cache.h
git checkout --ours path/to/kv_cache.h && git add path/to/kv_cache.h
# then continue
git cherry-pick --continue
```

ReleaseBot: CI pipeline triggered for branch hotfix/1.11.4 by Mason. Jobs: build, unit, e2e-streaming, smoke. Link: https://ci.internal/redwood/4321 :rocket: 

Olga: Rollback question — do we have a straightforward rollback plan if this introduces a perf regression? Also will this affect dedicated customer routing?

Mason: Good call. Rollback plan — if we see perf regressions post-cutover we do: 1) tag a rollback branch `release/1.11.4-rollback` off current release/1.11, 2) push a deploy rollback (hotfix revert commit), 3) ops will pin traffic to the previous variant for up to 2 hours while we debug. I'll coordinate with SRE.

Mason: On dedicated routing: this change is purely in the runtime KV handling for streaming; should be safe but we'll run a targeted smoke on a staging dedicated pool before cutting over prod.

Tessa: Drafted changelog bullet: "Fix streaming handler KV-cache overflow causing intermittent truncation of long responses. Patch 1.11.4." Pushing PR in ~8m.

Jay: Cherry-pick applied locally, small conflict in tests fixed. Pushing PR now: https://git.internal/redwood/release/pull/987 — running smoke.

ReleaseBot: Smoke tests passed for hotfix/1.11.4 — all green. (build: ✅, unit: ✅, e2e-streaming: ✅, smoke: ✅)

Olga: :thumbsup: good to go on my side. I'll notify the account teams if we schedule a brief customer-facing note.

Mason: Cutoff decision: expedite — cutoff in 25m from now. If no high-severity CI regressions, we cut and roll within the hour. If anything blocks, escalate in this thread and ping @SRE.

Tessa: Changelog PR merged. Release notes updated.

Jay: Deploy started to canary pool. Monitoring logs + latency dashboards. Will post status.

ReleaseBot: Deploy job started for hotfix/1.11.4 -> canary. Link: https://ci.internal/redwood/deploy/2157

Mason: Thanks all. Post any post-cutover anomalies here. If canary stable for 15m, we roll to prod.

Jay: Canary stable @ +12m, latency looks normal, no errors. Preparing full rollout.

ReleaseBot: Prod rollout complete. All monitors green.

Olga: Noted — sending customer heads-up now.

Mason: Closing this thread after propagation checks. Great job everyone. :tada:
